This idea is to allow users to represent a subverse. After hitting submit comment, your comment would show up like any normal comment but with a flair that reads /v/ideasforvoat if you chose that subverse to the right of the time stamp. As a regular user you'd have to have whatever the comment karma requirement is for that sub to downvote it. If you didn't have the required karma, a notification would show up saying so. People would have to choose carefully which opinion matches theirs the best instead of just upvoting everything that's on their side on downvoting everything that's not.
